role: Protocol contracts for Layer 2 perception pipeline inter-component communication and Layer 2/3 boundary
detail: Defines four @runtime_checkable protocols: FrameSource (async context manager producing camera frames, blocking I/O on __aenter__ released on __aexit__), ObjectDetector (synchronous CPU-bound YOLO interface with detect(frame) -> list[Detection], dispatched to thread executor by caller), ObjectTracker (synchronous SORT-style tracker with update(detections, frame_id) -> list[TrackedObject] maintaining TENTATIVE/CONFIRMED/LOST/DELETED track states), and PersistenceCheck (CANON A.5 narrow Layer 2->3 boundary with single find_match(observation) -> PersistenceResult|None method for identity resolution without direct graph writes). All protocols enforce structural subtyping at type-check time and runtime via isinstance() checks. Synchronous detectors and trackers avoid leaking event loops into domain logic by having callers wrap calls in loop.run_in_executor(). FrameSource returns None gracefully for transient frame gaps rather than raising.
gotchas: No notable stubs or TODOs; clean protocol definitions. Design enforces single-purpose boundary at Layer 2/3 per CANON A.5. PersistenceCheck deliberately NOT a full GraphPersistence interface (narrow crossing only).
